protocol.llada: full-last-external-v1, security-eval-score-only-json-v1 (prompt-only JSON; response_format ignored by the server, no logprobs), temperature 0, max_tokens 128, block_length 32, steps 32, threshold 0.5, editing_threshold 0.0, max_post_steps 16, editing on, MLX port, serial, Mac Studio
protocol.comparators: Studio Q8_0 GGUF baseline and abliteration pilot: same prompt and strategy, LM Studio, reasoning on, max_tokens 4096, serial, Mac Studio

scoring: Abstentions excluded from rates and reported separately. Per-test BA = mean of available class rates on scored cases; mean BA weights the 9 tests equally. AUROC = Mann-Whitney on scored cases, tests with both classes only; pooled AUROC pools all 998 cases. McNemar: exact, two-sided, on correct/incorrect for cases both models scored; Holm over the 6 pooled LLaDA-vs-reference tests; per-test p-values are uncorrected.

identicalCases.checked: label and model-input SHA-256 identical across all models (assertIdenticalCases)

prescreen.rule: clear if score <= t; escalate scores > t and every abstention to Gemma26; final flag = escalated AND Gemma26 flags
